reason: The text features multiple human characters with clear agency: Joshua chooses men and fights Amalek (וַיַּעַשׂ יְהוֹשֻׁעַ), Moses issues commands and holds the staff (וַיֹּאמֶר מֹשֶׁה אֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁעַ), Aaron and Hur actively support Moses by holding up his arms (תָּֽמְכוּ בְיָדָיו), and the Israelites engage in battle (יִשְׂרָאֵל). These are not merely passive agents—they make decisions, take actions, and their choices demonstrably affect outcomes (Israel prevails when Moses raises his hand, struggles when he lowers it).
